description_en: Pauses the playback of a video file during a voice call
description_zh: 在语音通话中插播视频文件时，暂停视频播放
name: PauseVideoFile

parameters.help_en: The call ID. Get the CallId from the return parameters of the SingleCallByVideo (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo?spm) interface
parameters.help_zh: 通话ID。您可以在SingleCallByVideo (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/vms/developer-reference/api-dyvmsapi-2017-05-25-singlecallbyvideo?spm)接口返回参数中获取CallId
parameters.name: call_id

parameters.help_en: The mobile phone number for which to pause video playback
parameters.help_zh: 暂停视频播放的手机号码
parameters.name: called_number

Code.description_en:
Request status code.

OK indicates a successful request.

For other error codes, see [API error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/112502.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。
返回OK代表请求成功。

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Values:

true: The call was successful.

false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
本次请求是否成功调用成功。取值：
